Card C00348-K1 is part of a coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring, with 6 online ProductCD='C' charges (3660245, 3660246, 3660247, 3660248, 3660249, 3660250) totaling $23.17, linked to 16 other cards in a January 2017 micro-skimming wave.

The transactions 3660245, 3660246, 3660247, 3660248, 3660249, 3660250 exhibit a cross-card / telemetry signature of multi-day sub-$6 online ProductCD='C' micro-charges, linking C00348-K1 to 16 peer cards.
The flagged online transaction 3660250 for $4.05 has no device identity record, indicating an unknown device rather than a new one.
The flagged transaction 3660250 for $4.05 occurred in billing region 264.0, which is a known region for card C00348-K1 with 54 prior purchases over 40 days.
The amount of transaction 3660250 ($4.05) is significantly lower than the card's prior median amount of $58.98 and prior maximum of $774.08 over 149 transactions.
The flagged transaction 3660250 has a low calibrated memory score (cms_p 0.001196) and a low real-time risk score (0.04).
No recurring charge pattern was detected for transaction 3660250 on card C00348-K1.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) addresses an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, case AC-HHF-005. The subjects are customer C00348 and debit card C00348-K1, which is connected to 16 other cards in a micro-skimming wave. On 2017-01-28, customer C00348 denied an online transaction 3660250 for $4.05, a Product C purchase in billing region 264.0. Investigation revealed this transaction is part of a series of six sub-$6 online Product C charges on card C00348-K1, starting on 2017-01-07 at 15:32:31 for $4.30 in region 325.0 (transaction 3660245), followed by $5.08 on 2017-01-15 at 22:51:07 (3660246), $2.70 on 2017-01-16 at 14:04:39 (3660247), $4.94 on 2017-01-18 at 19:30:07 (3660248), and $2.10 on 2017-01-20 at 11:03:40 (3660249), all in region 264.0, culminating in the denied transaction 3660250. This multi-day sub-$6 online Product C micro-charge skimming wave across 17 cards links card C00348-K1 to 16 other cards (C00129-K1, C01326-K2, C03427-K2, C03488-K1, C03611-K2, C04274-K1, C04528-K1, C05083-K1, C05263-K2, C06198-K1, C09471-K2, C10035-K2, C10654-K1, C11332-K1, C12975-K2, C13290-K1) targeted in the same January 2017 micro-skimming wave. The amounts of these online transactions, ranging from $2.10 to $5.08, are significantly below the card's prior median transaction amount of $58.98 and prior maximum of $774.08 over 149 transactions, which is unusual for the cardholder's historical spending. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. A fraud case was opened and connected cards are being monitored, while a block of card C00348-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval. This report is recommended and awaiting fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious amount of $23.17.
